mathkit.numerical_analysis.ChebyshevInte: Interpolating Runge's classic example, f(x) = 1/(1+25x^2), at equally spaced nodes on [-1, 1] makes the interpolation error diverge near the endpoints as the polynomial degree grows -- a famous 1901 counterexample to the intuition that more nodes always means a better fit. Clustering nodes near the endpoints instead, at the Chebyshev points, eliminates the divergence entirely.
